info.title: FreeFSM v1 pairing, own sessions, Job sync and field protocols
info.description: Interactive user protocol. Ten-minute pairing, authenticated hosted browser approval, one-use opaque bearer, coherent read-only authorized Job-context synchronization, exact-identity Subtask completion and immutable operation receipts. Field mutations and File transfers use their own documented endpoints. No API password or refresh-token flow.

post.description: At most100 operations and1048576 UTF-8 decoded JSON bytes, including whitespace. File bytes use separate endpoints. Content-Encoding is absent or identity. Full envelope validation precedes all admission; oversized envelopes reject413 without effects. Submitted order, one existing domain transaction per operation. Only earlier operations or known successful receipts in the same deployment/user/client binding may be dependencies; forward/self/unknown references are invalid_dependency, unsuccessful descendants failed_dependency. Terminal receipts are immutable; transient results have no terminal receipt. Occurrence never orders operations. Reconcile individual original receipts before retry; explicit reviewed repair uses new IDs and references. Supports Notes, semantic Job Status, independent Subtask completion/reopening, changed Job Custom Field Values, Comment add/reply/own-remove and own clock.in/clock.out with optional immutable GPS. Clock receipts use /time-operations; exact-entry close-out survives Job loss without renewed context. No planning/manual/correction/Void/other-user API or website offline mode.

200.description: Ordered per-operation receipts/errors; earlier committed effects survive later failures

200.description: Immutable terminal receipt

get.description: Read-only authorized Job-context snapshot or delta. Every parameter occurs at most once. Unknown parameters and simultaneous cursor/page are invalid_request (400). Keep scope and page_size identical throughout a chain. Every tokenless request creates a new snapshot, including initial-page replay/retry: discard prior cache and staging rather than merging materializations. Records are complete replacements keyed by opaque ID; removed IDs purge even prior staged pages. Apply the whole page atomically before advancing next_page; promote completion_cursor only after final local application. Never decode tokens. Token-bearing replay is idempotent state, not history, while continuity remains safe. Current authority is checked every page. Continuity is at least 30 days; unsafe/expired tokens require purge and resnapshot. Default sync budget 12/min/client is discoverable and configurable.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: all requires Job View A. Context facets always require explicit current assignment and independent grants.

200.description: Stable materialized page at watermark; completion token only on last page

409.description: Expired, unsafe, cross-client or filter-mismatched continuity. Observed assignment/deletion loss or changed grants/context durably invalidates existing snapshots for this authenticated user/session, including already-created successors. Unchanged reassignment does not revive invalidated tokens. Discard all cached Job/context and tokens before a fresh snapshot. Replaying an invalidated token does not invalidate later fresh snapshots.

get.description: Receipts have no expiry (at least 30 days); effect identities persist for their lifetime. Whole-instance restore can remove post-backup history: absence never proves an uncertain operation failed. Fresh same-user authentication permits read-only reconciliation, not rebinding the original client.

patch.description: Complete/Reopen require their independent current J/A grant. Exact UUID, opaque completion revision and operation ID are mandatory; positional indices are not supported. Same-state is a no-op, stale opposite-state/ABA conflicts. Planning maintenance is browser-only. Terminal receipts survive resource scope loss; audit/storage failure is retryable under the same ID.

patch.description: Independent job.fields.edit at J or A; planning grants never suffice. Per-field revision checks and all changed-value validation commit atomically with audit and receipt. Unrelated missing required values defer. Same-intent replay has no new effect. Terminal repair needs a new reviewed operation ID; transient retry retains the original. No legacy unguarded PATCH.

No Credit effect or disclosure, no amount shrink or retarget. Reconcile original receipt before another financial intent. Terminal rejection requires reviewed new identity; storage failure is nonterminal. Restore may lose post-backup receipts: explicit reconciliation, never blind replay.

get.description: Acceptance time and stable ID descending. Current row and facet Views apply before pagination. From is inclusive; until is exclusive. Unknown or repeated filters and filter-mismatched cursors reject. Customer-only documents, archived Jobs, administrative history and exports are not exposed here.

200.description: Complete authorized page; occurrence is absent when unknown

OperationID.name: Operation-ID
OperationID.description: Client-generated mutation UUID, independent of transfer and publication identities. Retain for unchanged retry; terminal repair requires a new reviewed UUID.

CommercialLifecycle.description: Job-bound lifecycle with independent Status or Finalize permission. Send the original whole-commercial revision plus target ID and meaning_revision from workflow. Cosmetic label/color changes remain valid; category/identity changes, ABA and commercial drift require explicit reselection/new operation ID. Active settlement rejects. Same-ID replay returns the original receipt even after resource access loss. Dependency/audit failures are nonterminal; inspect the original receipt before retry. No automatic finalize, unwind or overwrite.

CommercialCreate.description: Create once using a new client identity and operation identity. Job required; Customer-only fallback forbidden. Omitted defaults resolve explicit > Customer > company once. Invoice date defaults to company today. Optional date empty string explicitly clears/default-suppresses it.

CommercialEdit.description: Atomic patch against the originally read whole-commercial revision and Job. Disjoint stale/ABA edits conflict. Terminal rejection requires a new reviewed operation ID. Changed Custom Fields validate; unrelated missing required fields defer to online details save.

bearer.description: Opaque paired mobile session. Authorization: Bearer <token>. Cookies are not API credentials.

Error.description: Typed error. Inspect code and recovery_disposition, never parse message. 429 includes Retry-After (seconds). Unknown codes require explicit review.

target.description: Exact original parent identity: stable sync alias or installed decimal string. Never follow conversion.

parent_revision.description: Original collection eligibility_revision. Required for a new batch effect; missing/stale gives terminal comment_parent_changed409. Optional on the wire to preserve already-terminal legacy replay.

content.description: Plain text; Unicode code points, line breaks preserved. Whitespace-only and NUL reject.

reply_to.description: Exact open top-level Comment on this original parent

comment_id.description: Original installed effect identity, retained for compatible receipt lookup

parent_revision.description: Original eligibility witness required for any new API effect. Optional on the wire solely for immutable already-terminal legacy replay; missing/stale new intent receives409 comment_parent_changed.

Original eligibility witness required for a new removal or no-op request. Wire omission is retained solely for immutable already-terminal legacy replay; missing/stale new intent receives409 comment_parent_changed.

content.description: Empty for removed placeholders; historical stored text is not truncated

eligibility_revision.description: Opaque original lifecycle, Job relationship and own-assignment witness; ordinary field edits do not change it.

entry_ref.description: Exact decimal installed entry identity, at most9223372036854775807; mutually exclusive with entry_id.

job_ref.description: Exact decimal installed Job identity, at most9223372036854775807; mutually exclusive with job_id.

status_id.description: Original definition identity from status_definitions; never silently replace by label or category.

job_id.description: Recorded original Job target for accepted field operations, retained after scope loss.

effect_id.description: For field changes, the operation identity already recorded in immutable mutation audit. Never inferred for historical/no-op receipts without that fact.

occurred_at.description: Optional client occurrence evidence, never authority or ordering; may not be future.
Optional nonfuture occurrence at microsecond precision, immutable command and audit evidence; never authority.

file_id.description: Legacy numeric target identity; use effect_id for precision-safe accepted identity.

effect_id.description: Existing File identity as an exact decimal string on accepted receipts, including no-ops.

SignedCents.description: Exact signed int64 USD cents, serialized as a string to preserve every digit.

tax_exempt.description: Exemption captured for this accepted monetary revision, not a live Customer projection.

status_id.description: Preserved manual identity; null is an unknown retained state requiring explicit selection.

manual_category.description: Null preserves an unknown retained manual status; reads never infer Draft.

effective_category.description: Null when a retained status has no known effective presentation.

settlement_locked.description: Invoice commercial lock, not a financial balance.

line_items.description: Captured inputs, omitted without pricing authority. Historical reads retain recorded precision even where a new monetary write requires cent inputs.

value.description: Nonnegative exact decimal. Fixed USD requires exactly two decimal places; percentage is an exact decimal percent, not a fraction.

CommercialAdjustments.description: Replace both document adjustments; {} clears both. Discount precedes surcharge, proportionally allocated across current positive lines; largest remainder, original line order ties. A nonzero fixed surcharge with no positive targets rejects.

due_date.description: ISO date or empty string for explicit No Due Date

valid_through.description: Estimate only; ISO date or empty string for no expiry

quantity.description: Positive plain-decimal string recommended. Compatible finite JSON numeric forms, including scientific notation, are also accepted. Reads always emit strings to avoid binary float loss.

tax_rate.description: Retained catalog provenance; document tax_rate governs accepted tax.

discount.description: Legacy fixed-input alias; cannot combine a nonzero value with discount_adjustment.

surcharge.description: Legacy fixed-input alias; cannot combine a nonzero value with surcharge_adjustment.

CommercialLine.description: Signed price; negative-price lines cannot carry adjustments. Base and each adjustment result round half away from zero to cents, discount floors at zero. Accepted financial version 1 is returned under financial with exact input and result cents encoded as decimal integer strings. Historical documents without financial retain their recorded arithmetic until a reviewed monetary edit; metadata edits and conversions preserve it.

occurred_at.description: Staged occurrence, requires lease_id. Omit for online server-time clock.

entry_ref.description: Exact decimal spelling of entry_id for clients with limited integer precision.

OpaqueID.description: Opaque persistent identity, never decode, infer an installed integer ID or reuse.

kind.description: Empty legacy Kind remains unspecified, never inferred.

publication_id.description: Null when historical publication identity was not recorded.

legacy_values.description: Unmarked or unrecognized original evidence, retained verbatim and read-only; never infer definition identities from labels or JSON-looking text.

clock_job_id.description: Existing clock command Job identity, only with own Clock-in grant; current acceptance still rechecks Job access.

category.description: Empty when no Status was recorded on installed data; do not infer a category.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (including UTC); instants carry explicit RFC3339 offsets.

role.description: Legacy display label; never an authorization condition
